$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for this file, for editor completion.

asOf.description: "latest_data" (the newest source horizon), "latest_common_data" (the oldest, so every chart ends on the same day) or a fixed YYYY-MM-DD, so builds are reproducible.

Period.description: Defaults to {asOf: latest_data, range: last_12_months, compare: previous_period}.

end.description: Local date after the last, exclusive.

Range.description: A date range [start, end) in the project time zone: {start: 2026-02-01, end: 2026-11-01}, or a shorthand resolved at the as-of date: {last: 30, unit: day}, {to_date: quarter}, {last_complete: month}, or a named range such as "last_12_months".

by.description: Units to move the first and last day by; negative is earlier. The moved window must stay within 0001-01-01 to 9998-12-31.

Comparison.description: previous_period: the previous calendar unit for calendar ranges (October vs September; to-date ranges compare the same elapsed span), or the same length just before for rolling ranges (last N days, last 12 months). previous_year: the same span one year earlier. {shift: {unit: week, by: -1}}: the range moved by whole units. none: no comparison.

column.description: Filters every block whose metric table has this column.

options.description: Presets the reader picks from, such as [{last: 7, unit: day}, {to_date: month}, {last_complete: month}, last_12_months]. Each is computed exactly at build time.

default.description: The preset the page shows first; one of options.

custom.description: Also offer a calendar for any start and end date. Default true. A static build embeds day-grain aggregates for it; set false to offer only the presets and keep the page small (HM5002).

options.description: Grains to switch between. Drives every time-series block whose grains list the chosen grain.

segments.description: Segments the reader turns on and off: names of files under segments/. Selected segments combine with AND.

default.description: Segments on when the page opens; some of segments. Default: none (all rows).

anchor.description: Overrides the project anchor: a weekday for weeks, MM-DD for quarters and years, such as "07-01" for a year from July 1.

anyOf.description: Where a quarter or year bucket begins, such as "02-01".

Grain.description: A bucket unit, such as "month", or {unit: year, anchor: 02-01} to override the project anchors.

id.description: Stable block id. Defaults to <type>_<index>; set it to keep links and caches across reorders.

height.description: Size of the figure and sparkline: "compact", "default" or "tall". KPIs in one strip are drawn at the tallest preset among them.

metric.description: A metric name, the file name under metrics/.

compare.description: Defaults to the dashboard period's compare.

height.description: Card height: "compact", "default" or "tall". The theme sets the pixels for desktop and phone; there are no pixel heights. Charts side by side in a grid row are drawn at the tallest preset among them.

items.description: A metric name, the file name under metrics/.

grains.description: Grains the card switches between, such as [week, month, quarter]. grain is the default and must be one of them. A grain filter drives every block that lists its chosen grain.

edges.description: Where the first bucket starts. "snap" (default) starts the window at the start of the bucket it falls in, so the first bucket is whole; "clip" keeps the window start and marks the first bucket partial.

incomplete.description: Buckets the data doesn't fully cover. "mark" (default) lists them in each series' partial; "hide" leaves them out; "show" draws them as complete buckets (check warns with HM4014 for a flow metric).

split.description: Column that splits one metric into series.

groups.description: Series that belong together, such as actual, target and forecast of one metric. A group shares one hue and steps through its lightness in the order listed; ungrouped series keep their usual colours. At most 3 groups, and a series belongs to one group only.

label.description: The group's name in the key, the tooltip and the data table, such as Revenue.

series.description: Series that belong together, lead series first. Each is a metric name from metrics or, with split, a split value as the chart labels it. At most 3.

totals.description: Total row, recomputed from rows (not summed). Default true.

percentOfTotal.description: Metrics that also show their share of the total. Additive metrics only.

items.description: A metric name, the file name under metrics/.

limit.description: Rows shown, after sort. With subtotals, rows shown in each innermost group. Tables do not paginate.

other.description: With limit: fold the rows past the limit into one "Other" row, recomputed from those rows.

subtotals.description: A subtotal row for every group of each outer by column, recomputed from rows (not summed). Needs two or more by columns.

bars.description: Metrics that draw a bar in their cells, scaled across the rows shown.

items.description: A metric name, the file name under metrics/.

overflow.description: How a table past 15 rows fits: "page" grows with the page, its header and total pinned to the screen edges; "scroll" scrolls inside its card. Default: "page" when the table is alone in its grid row, else "scroll".

id.description: Stable block id. Defaults to <type>_<index>; set it to keep links and caches across reorders.

height.description: Card height: "compact", "default" or "tall". The theme sets the pixels for desktop and phone; there are no pixel heights. Charts side by side in a grid row are drawn at the tallest preset among them.

by.description: Category column: one point per value.

size.description: Metric drawn as the point's area (a bubble chart). Omit for dots.

limit.description: Points kept, largest first (by size, else by y). Default: every category, up to 500.

id.description: Stable block id. Defaults to <type>_<index>; set it to keep links and caches across reorders.

geo.description: Boundaries to draw: "us-states" (50 states, DC and Puerto Rico) or "world-countries".

region.description: Column naming the region of each row: a code (ISO 3166 alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric, USPS, FIPS) or a name, matched case- and accent-insensitively.

value.description: Metric that colours each region. A rate, ratio or average reads well on a filled map; a sum or count mostly shows where people are (HM5040).

shape.description: "regions" (default): the real boundaries. "tiles": one equal tile per state, DC and Puerto Rico, so small states read as clearly as large ones; us-states only.

tile.description: The tile of shape "tiles": "square" (default), the clearest grid for state codes at any width, or "hex", which keeps more neighbours touching.

pair.description: "bars" (default): a ranked bar list beside the map with the same values, below it on narrow cards. "none": the map alone.

missing.description: How regions without a value are drawn: "hatch" (default).

MapBlock.description: A filled (choropleth) map of one metric by region.

type.description: "quantile" (default): each class holds about the same number of regions. "threshold": classes split at your breaks. "linear": classes of equal width between the lowest and highest value.

classes.description: Number of colour classes, 3 to 7. Default 5. With threshold breaks it is breaks + 1 and may be left out.

breaks.description: Class boundaries in the metric's unit, ascending, for type threshold. A value equal to a break falls in the class above it.

midpoint.description: Makes the scale diverging: values below the midpoint take one hue, values above it the other. Use it for change, margin or a gap to a target.

id.description: Stable block id. Defaults to <type>_<index>; set it to keep links and caches across reorders.

markdown.description: Markdown. {{metric}} inserts the current value; {{metric.previous}}, {{metric.change}} and {{metric.change_pct}} insert the comparison.
